readings: Consider each event (`budget.link_to_event`) and compute its average budget `amount` across its budget lines, ignoring NULL amounts. Define the overall average budget amount as the average of `amount` across all individual budget lines, ignoring NULLs. Keep events whose average exceeds that line-level overall average. For each, show the event link, its average amount, its average minus the line-level overall average, and its average minus the mean of the per-event averages among the kept events. Return the top 10 ordered by that last gap, largest first.

Consider each event (`budget.link_to_event`) and compute its average budget `amount` across its budget lines, ignoring NULL amounts. Define the overall average budget amount as the average of those per-event averages, so each event counts equally whatever its number of budget lines. Keep events whose average exceeds that mean of per-event averages. For each, show the event link, its average amount, its average minus that overall mean of per-event averages, and its average minus the mean of the per-event averages among the kept events. Return the top 10 ordered by that last gap, largest first.
queries:
WITH ev AS (
    SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount
    FROM budget
    GROUP BY link_to_event
    HAVING AVG(amount) IS NOT NULL
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(amount) AS overall_avg
    FROM budget
),
kept AS (
    SELECT ev.link_to_event, ev.avg_amount, overall.overall_avg
    FROM ev, overall
    WHERE ev.avg_amount > overall.overall_avg
)
SELECT
    link_to_event,
    avg_amount,
    avg_amount - overall_avg AS diff_from_overall,
    avg_amount - (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) FROM kept) AS diff_from_kept_mean
FROM kept
ORDER BY diff_from_kept_mean DESC
LIMIT 10;
WITH per_event AS (
    SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount
    FROM budget
    WHERE amount IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY link_to_event
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS overall_mean
    FROM per_event
),
kept AS (
    SELECT p.link_to_event, p.avg_amount
    FROM per_event p, overall o
    WHERE p.avg_amount > o.overall_mean
),
kept_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS kept_mean
    FROM kept
)
SELECT k.link_to_event,
       k.avg_amount,
       k.avg_amount - o.overall_mean AS diff_overall,
       k.avg_amount - km.kept_mean AS diff_kept
FROM kept k, overall o, kept_mean km
ORDER BY diff_kept DESC
LIMIT 10;
